title: Twitch Streamer Kitboga Sings Africa To Tech Support Scammer

Who knows what the new world record will be! His channel is www.twitch.tv/kitboga  go give him a follow and watch his stream it is HILARIOUS !    EDIT: He made the new record at 3 hours and 5 minutes! Check out his channel:   www.twitch.tv/kitboga
